rationale: Apple text measurement and CoreGraphics paint resolve one face: a CoreText face registry (bundled fonts plus register_font faces) that the CoreGraphics canvas paints through and, without Skia, TextShaper measures through, using Skia's CoreText metric definitions. Before it, CTFontCreateWithName answered Helvetica for the bundled Inter, so a CPU-painted label was measured as Inter and painted as Helvetica, and without Skia it was not measured at all. bundled_fonts.cpp reads the embedded font table from a Skia-free TU and also files Skia registrations with the CoreText registry; font_registry_stubs.cpp registers through CoreText on Apple without Skia. Faces stay in Pulp's own table, never CTFontManager. No API is removed and no design-import, Chromium, rendering-backend, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
